endorsements.name: Simon Scannell and Anthony Weems
endorsements.label: The Mines of Kakadûm: Blindly Exploiting Load-Balanced Services
endorsements.description: Exploits leveraging memory corruption vulnerabilities typically require some knowledge about the target environment, such as the binary, OS, and allocator. These insights are required to e.g. prepare the heap and deploy ROP chain gadgets. As a result, exploits typically target client-side software such as browsers and phones. Read more
